title: Word Hunt · Scrambly
objective: Swipe to connect adjacent letters on a 4x4 grid to form target words (SUN, SEA, SAND) and earn cash rewards.
controls: Tap or swipe across adjacent letter tiles on the 4x4 grid to connect them into words, or tap the Hint button.
core_loop: Swipe across letters on the grid to form a listed target word -> earn the displayed cash reward ($0.30-$0.40) -> add to the total cash balance.
features: Target word list with cash values (SUN $0.30, SEA $0.30, SAND $0.40)
progression: Complete all target words on the current board to earn cash rewards and advance to subsequent word boards.
hook_idea: 0.0-2.0s showing the $0.00 cash counter, fox mascot, and the highlighted 'SUN' ($0.30) tutorial prompt, which immediately communicates the play-for-rewards hook.
